figurative_meaning_en: Knowledge of one's lineage and character
example_sentences_in_bangla: অজ্ঞাত কুলশীলকে ঘরে স্থান দেওয়া উচিত নয়।
বিয়ের আগে ছেলের কুলশীল জেনে নাও।
example_sentences_in_english: One should not give shelter to an unknown person of unverified lineage and character.
Before marriage, make sure to know the boy's family background and character.
history: This idiom reflects traditional Bengali societal norms emphasizing family verification before alliances or hospitality.
note: Often used in contexts of marriage or hosting strangers to avoid risks.
